title: 2023年6月六级写作：面对分歧时的友好讨论
prompt:
续写作文：以下列句子开头写一篇文章："When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument." 可以发表评论、举例或结合个人经历展开。（150-200词）

开头句：When faced with differing opinions, we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument.
